publicProfile: Owen Fletcher's grandfather and primary family support.
individualTimeline: Episode 36: Arthur first appears as Owen Fletcher's unnamed grandfather.
Episode 44: Arthur contacts Kairos about Owen's pending evaluation decision.
Episode 45: Arthur accepts the three-week evaluation plan after Kairos guarantees Owen's return travel if no contract follows.
Episode 54: Arthur's chemotherapy is responding well, and Adrian presents Project Casa Arthur as a conditional future plan.
Episode 56: Arthur still lives in Mackenzie; no relocation, construction, acceptance, or medical approval has occurred.
Episode 63: Owen reports that Arthur intends to move near the Kairos campus in early 2027, subject to safe travel and independent medical approval.
Episode 86: Arthur has relocated from Mackenzie to the Kairos campus residential area; the exact travel date is not established.
Episode 119 (2027-01-30): Lives in the campus residential area, watches the Main train and tells Owen not to refuse opportunities because of him.
Episode 120 (2027-01-31): Attends the first half of the LA Galaxy match with Owen and receives a Galaxy cap.
Episode 124 (2027-02-03): Develops chills and a 38.4 C fever during chemotherapy and is admitted to a hospital in Los Angeles; stable.
Episode 126 (2027-02-05): Encouraging signs, no new fever; still hospitalised with no safe discharge forecast; tells Owen the decision about Austin must be his.
Episode 128 (2027-02-07): Joins the team dinner in Austin by video, stable and improving.
